addr: HSR, 1001, 9th Main Rd, 7th Sector, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: As everyone knows, DBC at Corner House is absolutely iconic and truly lives up to the hype. As someone who has always had a sweet tooth, this has been my go-to dessert spot for years. Whether it's dining in or ordering at home, every visit …

This is a branch of famous corner house. The ambience is old fashioned. Ice creams and sundaes are great here. Most of the sundaes will have nuts, which is the usp of this place. Service is quick. Prices are budget friendly. Overall a very good ice cream parlor

Visited the Hsr outlet of corner house, suprised to see such less crowd during a Saturday Eve! Tried their cake fudge sundae. Definitely recommend it over the Death by chocolate! Dbc is more on the face and you get too satiated after few spoons with all the whipped cream.
